manifest.test_set_note: Target-matched bare-failed genre. The Ainglish arm also carries an explicit outcome explanation absent from the English arm, as in the routed original; this run therefore tests that complete-report contrast, not the isolated token cost of either tag.

comparison_identity.class_mix: 13 verdict-fail / 19 no-verdict; nearest 32-item approximation to target 4:6
comparison_identity.truth_boundary: does not estimate a lossless tag-only substitution
comparison_identity.comparator: a marked check report carrying its explicit outcome explanation versus a terse bare-'failed' sentence that omits that explanation
comparison_identity.population: 32 fresh operational check reports: 13 completed adverse verdicts and 19 instrument-side no-result cases, approximating the target's 4:6 class mix
comparison_identity.aggregation: equal-item mean per tokenizer, then maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable)

manifest.selection: Thirty-two complete pairs fixed before tokenizer loading or counting; zero exact pair overlap with the target; all finite outcomes will be filed once.
manifest.method: Compute tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) for every pair and tokenizer; take the equal-item mean per tokenizer and the maximum lineage mean as headline.
